name: Eight Sleep
author: Daniel Zuccon
description: Your Eight Sleep Pod in the Omarchy bar: the current level and mode of your side, ↑/↓ to adjust it, on/off, and last night's sleep score, stages and vitals.

barWidget.description: Your side of an Eight Sleep Pod, read and controlled through the app's API. Badge shows the level (or temperature or sleep score); the panel shows bed state, controls and last night's sleep.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll Eight Sleep. The official app polls about this often; 60 s is the floor.

schema.label: Temperature units
schema.description: Eight Sleep levels (−10..+10) are shown alongside an approximate surface temperature.

schema.label: Number on the badge
schema.description: level = your side's target level. temp = current surface temperature. score = last night's sleep score.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: Desktop notification when last night's sleep score arrives, or when the Pod goes offline or needs water.
